انحملوا (form VII)
# اِنْحَمَلُوا (inḥamalū) /in.ħa.ma.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْحَمَلَ (inḥamala)
# اِنْحَمِلُوا (inḥamilū) /in.ħa.mi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْحَمَلَ (inḥamala)
